main_text.head: CAP. XII.
De mortuorum in Cruce suspensione.
main_text.p: Mortui in Crucem dati.A Ç postremò Crux Fine alia, cùm non vivi sed mortui in eâ appensi. Notabis. & quod nobis solenne in rotâ exponere supplicio jam affectos, ad notam sceleris & infamiam, id olim in Cruce, & Orientalibus præsertim. Dati.De Romanis nondum legi. nisi

page.notes: Greek passage in the head paragraph is printed in small italic type and is transcribed as far as legible; the catchword "nisi" is at the foot right. Margin notes read "Et Suet." and "tonsk." (partly damaged). Marginal word "Dati" is partly obscured.
